PSS (proportional set size) shares shared pages proportionally, so the per-worker column is not independently owned RAM. The total is the sum of reported PSS values, not extra physical RAM on top of the app\'s own PSS.

Results appear after a run. Waiting time = turnaround time − burst time.
Average waiting time: %1$.2f · Average turnaround time: %2$.2f
Run both FCFS and Round Robin to compare their averages.
First Come, First Served (FCFS): jobs run to completion in arrival order. It is simple and easy to compute by hand, but one long job delays every job behind it (the convoy effect).

Round Robin (RR): the ready queue is served in order, each job running for at most one time quantum before moving on. Short jobs finish sooner and every job is treated fairly; smaller quanta mean more context switches.
